Overview & City Profile

Valdemoro (Valdemoro (Provincia de Madrid)) is a municipality in Provincia de Madrid, Community of Madrid (coordinates 40.1808°N, -3.6498°E; population 74,745). Visitors use Valdemoro as a base to explore Community of Madrid's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Cocido Madrileño, Bocadillo de calamares, Huevos rotos con jamón.

Within Community of Madrid Region (Provincia de Madrid region), Valdemoro (Valdemoro (Provincia de Madrid)) serves as a municipio (municipality) in community of madrid region. Travelers exploring Community of Madrid often combine a stop in Valdemoro with regional highlights such as Prado, Reina Sofía & Thyssen-Bornemisza Museums, Royal Palace & Retiro Park, San Lorenzo de El Escorial, Aranjuez & Alcalá de Henares.

Getting to Valdemoro & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Madrid Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)): Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD); Puerta de Atocha and Chamartín stations are the center of Spain's radial AVE rail network.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Community of Madrid Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Madrid with Valdemoro. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep €1,000 bills and €100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Community of Madrid have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Valdemoro en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Valdemoro are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail station or airport in Community of Madrid can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Practical Travel Tips for Valdemoro

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Valdemoro (or at Madrid Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Valdemoro accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Spain Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Valdemoro (Valdemoro (Provincia de Madrid)) located in Spain?

Valdemoro (Valdemoro (Provincia de Madrid)) is a municipio (municipality) located in Community of Madrid Region in the Provincia de Madrid region of Spain (coordinates: 40.1808°N, -3.6498°E). It has a population of approximately 74,745 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Valdemoro by train?

Most visitors reach Valdemoro via the main prefectural gateway of Madrid Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail). Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD); Puerta de Atocha and Chamartín stations are the center of Spain's radial AVE rail network. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Valdemoro. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare Calculator.

What local food is Valdemoro and Community of Madrid known for?

In Valdemoro and across Community of Madrid Region, top local dishes include Cocido Madrileño, Bocadillo de calamares, Huevos rotos con jamón, as well as Churros con chocolate at San Ginés and Vermut de grifo. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Valdemoro?
